efficio_render_behavior.purpose: Tells the renderer how to treat the shape.

enum_descriptions.render_by_component_type: Render the shape using its component type contract.
enum_descriptions.preserve: Keep the shape exactly as authored; do not generate content for it.
enum_descriptions.remove_on_render: Drop the shape from the rendered output (mock/preview only).

efficio_prompt_instruction.purpose: Free-form instruction passed to content generation for this component.

efficio_default_subtype.purpose: The approval subtype to use unless a more appropriate one is selected.

enum_descriptions.recommended: A recommendation that is not yet a formal sign-off.
enum_descriptions.endorsed: A stronger endorsement, short of final approval.

efficio_subtype_policy.purpose: Whether generation may choose the approval subtype for this block.

enum_descriptions.ai_selectable: Generation may choose the approval subtype from the configured subtypes.

efficio_missing_content_behavior.purpose: What to do when no approval content is generated for this block.

enum_descriptions.leave_as_is: Keep an unselected/empty approval block unchanged rather than removing it.

efficio_approval_block_subtypes.purpose: The display label to render for each approval subtype.

expected_content_schema.description: Expected AI output for an approval block. null leaves the block unchanged; an object selects an approval subtype and fills the approver name and role.
